summary: Keep controller progress stable during RPC timeouts and show the current indexer target
details: Apply the existing bounded last-good display cache when up follows the bootstrap controller, retaining heights with a STALE label while keeping the current failed probe state.
Display the indexer's committed height and observed upstream stable height instead of the previous scan batch target, with an explicit remaining block count.
Keep controller readiness decisions and one-shot progress JSON based on fresh observations; historical display values never open startup gates.
operator_actions: Use the updated node kit and reopen the progress view to apply the display fixes; running data services do not need a restart.
